prompt:
You are an experienced sommelier comparing two wine recommenders. A
customer with no wine knowledge made this request:

"Can you recommend a light sparkling wine with a creamy feel and peach flavors that would go well with a fish dinner?"

List A:
Wine 1: Pinot Grigio, Italy, $22. Tasting note: "There's a creamy, full quality to this wine that is backed by aromas of mature peach, yellow flower and honey. It has an easy approach and would pair well with salmon or swordfish carpaccio."
Wine 2: Brachetto, Italy, $17. Tasting note: "Here's a ruby-colored sparkling dessert wine that would pair with chocolate-covered strawberries, panna cotta or apricot tart. Fruity and cheerful, aromas here include raspberry, white cherry and cranberry. Creamy foaming is capped by bright crispness to keep the mouth refreshed."
Wine 3: Glera, Italy, $13. Tasting note: "This bright sparkling wine delivers a touch of sassy spice in front of softer aromas of stone fruit, white flower and dried herb. Pair this with cocktail snacks, like potato chips or green olives."
Wine 4: Mauzac, France, $24. Tasting note: "A lightly sparkling, earthy wine, with just off dry melon and almond flavors. A wine that is delicious as an apéritif or with lighter fish and cheese dishes."
Wine 5: White Blend, Italy, $16. Tasting note: "Bright and citrus-driven, this no-fuss wine would pair with grilled shrimp or freshwater fish. The wine is zesty and fresh overall."

List B:
Wine 1: Moscato, Italy, price unknown. Tasting note: "Fun and refreshing, this lightly sparkling dessert wine offers aromas and flavors of ripe yellow peach, candied tangerine zest and a hint of aromatic herb. Modest acidity stops it from being cloying."
Wine 2: Pinot Grigio, Italy, $22. Tasting note: "There's a creamy, full quality to this wine that is backed by aromas of mature peach, yellow flower and honey. It has an easy approach and would pair well with salmon or swordfish carpaccio."
Wine 3: Müller-Thurgau, US, $12. Tasting note: "This simple and sweet wine has a light peach flavor with a sugary—not syrupy—finish. It might be a good wine to soak fruit in for a light dessert."
Wine 4: Sparkling Blend, Italy, $34. Tasting note: "This straightforward sparkling wine offers peach aromas, with hints of roasted almond that carry over to the palate. This is refreshing, with a frothy texture and crisp acidity."
Wine 5: Chardonnay, Italy, $50. Tasting note: "Creamy and yeasty, this luminous Chardonnay-based sparkler delivers aroma of mature peach and apricot backed by almond nut and butter. The wine has the heft and staying power to pair with shellfish or lobster."

Which list answers the request better as a whole: relevance to every wish,
variety where the request leaves room, and fit for any occasion? If they
are equally good, say tie. Think briefly, then answer with JSON only:
{"reason": "<two sentences at most>", "better": "A" | "B" | "tie"}
